status: Exploratory third-party continuous NIFTY_F1 futures proxy, not exchange contract-level validation; no tuning after outcomes.

rules.gap_fade: Spot first normal-session open differs from previous observed 15:30 close by at least 0.5%. Fade gap at futures bar labelled 09:22 open; signal determined by 09:20. Stop 0.5 prior daily spot ATR14; target 1.0 ATR. Exit bar labelled15:15 open.
rules.gap_fade_confirmed: Same gap fade, additionally spot close labelled09:20 lies strictly between opening spot price and previous session close (partial reversal, not already filled).
rules.opening_range: Futures range of labels09:16..09:30. First close above high or below low after09:30 and no later12:00 triggers corresponding direction. Fill open two timestamp-minutes later. Stop opposite range end; target2R. Skip if entry no longer outside range. Exit label15:15 open. One signal/day.

sizing: Integer lots, full notional <= equity and planned stop loss including estimated costs <=0.5% equity; one trade/day. No financing, cash interest or personal income taxes. Gap-through stops can lose more.
cost_note: Scenarios, not exact historical broker tariffs. Lower cost may understate current taxes. Stress doubles conservative assumptions.
execution: No bar-close fills. Gap stops use worse opening price; if stop and target touched same minute stop first; take-profit requires trade through target by0.05. No overnight positions. Never infer order from OHLC. Timestamp convention undocumented; at least one full timestamp minute between signal close label and entry-bar start under either start/end label convention.
audit: Do not silently drop losses or repair prices. Exclude only bars outside09:16..15:30 from regular-session calculations. Missing held minute bars are flagged, never filled forward. All selected-trade logs retained.
